name: KIDS STAR Inc.
summary: KIDS STAR Inc. engages in planning, developing, producing, and operating educational apps for children in Japan. The company offers Gokko Land, a social experience app that provides experiential digital content and job simulations via smart devices about corporate brands, products, and local governments. It also provides contract development, proof of concept and development support, and service design services. KIDS STAR Inc. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
